The gate works by using three signals to decide whether a frame deserves to reach a model: structural perceptual-hash distance, photometric mean absolute pixel delta, and semantic embedding cosine distance [describe_architecture]. 

The tool results do not provide information on how I decide what to escalate.
How does your memory compression work?

The memory compression works by using three stores: ENTITIES, THE TEMPORAL PYRAMID, and THE BASELINE [describe_architecture]. ENTITIES store identity that survives across frames, sessions, and days. THE TEMPORAL PYRAMID is a hierarchical compression that collapses an eight-hour shift into a summary, with salience-weighted compression. THE BASELINE stores counts per (zone, hour, class), scored by departure from history.

message.content: The scalability limit is that sending every frame to a vision model is arithmetically impossible due to the free model tier's request limit [describe_architecture]. The system is designed to ration model calls, with a measured result of 38.9% of frames never reaching a VLM on real footage, and 94.6% on idle footage [describe_architecture]. The honest limit is that a busier site spends more, and a site busy enough that most frames are novel would exhaust the budget [describe_architecture].
